rawText: VECCHIE VIGNE - SORÌ PAITIN - BARBARESCO - DENOMINAZIONE DI ORIGINE PROTETTA - RISERVA 2015 - N°110 - Imbottigliato all'origine da PAITIN - Pasquero Elia - PROPRIETARI PRODUTTORI - NEIVE - ITALIA
description: Barbaresco DOCG requires a minimum of 26 months' ageing for the base wine and 50 months for Riserva, of which at least 9 months in wood. Paitin is a historic estate in Neive, run by the Pasquero-Elia family, whose Sorì Paitin vineyard is one of the oldest single-vineyard sites in the Barbaresco zone. The Vecchie Vigne bottling is produced from old vines planted decades ago on this cru.
